meta.name: El problema de los 3 cuerpos
meta.description: Cinco brillantes amigos hacen descubrimientos asombrosos mientras las leyes de la naturaleza se revelan ante sus ojos y una amenaza existencial se cierne sobre la humanidad.
meta.country: China, United Kingdom, United States of America

videos.title: Cuenta regresiva
videos.overview: Una serie de eventos perturbadores lleva a un grupo de brillantes amigos al límite mientras se devela un misterio que se remonta a China durante la Revolución Cultural.

videos.title: Costa Roja
videos.overview: La cuenta atrás de Auggie pone en riesgo su trabajo en nanotecnología. Jin se obsesiona con un juego de realidad virtual de otro mundo. Ye Wenjie pone en práctica una idea radical.

videos.title: Destructor de mundos
videos.overview: Obsesionados con su misión en el juego virtual, Jin y Jack se apresuran para resolver un acertijo complejo. Sin embargo, el paso al siguiente nivel trae consecuencias desastrosas.

videos.title: Su Señoría
videos.overview: Jin busca justicia cuando una muerte sacude al equipo. Antes de una importante cumbre, los investigadores descubren a un grupo extremista que adora a una entidad de otro mundo.

videos.title: Juicio Final
videos.overview: Mientras el nivel de amenaza aumenta, se pone en marcha una misión secreta en territorio peligroso para obtener información del enemigo. La Tierra recibe un mensaje aterrador.

videos.title: Estrellas Destino Nuestro
videos.overview: El mundo entra en pánico tras una declaración trascendental. Wade reúne a las mentes más brillantes del planeta para preparar un plan de defensa.

videos.title: Un avance
videos.overview: Una propuesta atrevida para el Proyecto Escalera genera tensión en el grupo. Will evalúa sus opciones. Ye regresa a un lugar familiar.

videos.title: Proyecto Vallado
videos.overview: Una operación importante pone a Saul en riesgo. Con grandes emociones y expectativas, la sonda se lanza al espacio, y la humanidad comienza una nueva y aterradora era.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 1
videos.overview: For episode 1, “Countdown,” creators David Benioff, D.B. Weiss, and Alexander Woo discuss ensuring the historical accuracy of the Cultural Revolution, introducing the Oxford 5, and establishing the mystery that will slowly unfold throughout the season.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 2
videos.overview: For episode 2, “Red Coast,” Cast member Zine Tseng (Ye Wenjie) examines her character’s decision to reply to the message from space, while Alex Sharp (Will Downing) and John Bradley (Jack Rooney) explain the solemnity of Will’s medical diagnosis.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 3
videos.overview: For episode 3, “Destroyer of Worlds,” 3 Body Problem series creators Benioff, Weiss, and Woo discuss developing the show’s VR headset and the Sophon persona, a shocking character death, and collaborating with Oscar-winning director Andrew Stanton on the VR world.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 4
videos.overview: For episode 4, “Our Lord,” 3 Body Problem creators and Jonathan Pryce (Mike Evans) discuss fairytales and the concept of lying. Director Minkie Spiro talks about the big Ye Wenjie reveal of the episode and why Spiro filmed it the way she did, while Rosalind Chao (Ye Wenjie) comments on the intentions behind Ye’s fateful decision.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 5
videos.overview: For episode 5, “Judgment Day,” 3 Body Problem creators and Benedict Wong (Da Shi) weigh the sacrifices the show’s protagonists have made up to this point. Director Minkie Spiro and actor Liam Cunningham (Thomas Wade) discuss the creation of the epic Judgment Day scene, and its tragic aftermath.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 6
videos.overview: For episode 6, “The Stars Our Destination,” Jess Hong (Jin Cheng) and Liam Cunningham (Thomas Wade) evaluate Jin's brilliant tactical plan, the first step in Earth’s defense strategy, while Eiza González (Auggie Salazar) questions the moral implications. Alex Sharp (Will Downing) gives more insight into his character, and the relationship between Jin and Will. Rosalind Chao (Ye Wenjie) shares her feelings about Ye’s true motivations.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 7
videos.overview: For episode 7, “Only Advance,” Jess Hong analyzes the nature of Jin’s relationship with Raj (Saamer Usmani) versus Will (Alex Sharp), who makes the ultimate romantic confession on his deathbed. Rosalind Chao (Ye Wenjie) teases Ye’s intentions with the “Einstein in Heaven” joke she tells Saul (Jovan Adepo) and reflects on her character's tasteful off-screen demise.

videos.title: Inside the Episodes - Episode 8
videos.overview: For episode 8, “Wallfacer,” Jovan Adepo (Saul Durand) predicts how Saul will handle what’s been given to him. The 3 Body Problem series creators and director Jeremy Podeswa dissect the emotionally suspenseful rocket launch scene, and what it could mean for the story going forward.
